# `/setup`

Scope: installs the binary and writes the project file. It does not author notes (see
`/author`) or publish them (see `/publish`).

## Steps

1. Run `skillwright --version`. If it prints a version, go to step 4.

2. Install the binary with one of the release channels, then run `skillwright --version` again:

   ```sh
   brew install osdlc/tap/skillwright
   npm install --global @osdlc/skillwright   # or run once: npx @osdlc/skillwright --help
   cargo binstall skillwright
   cargo install skillwright
   curl -fsSL https://github.com/osdlc/skillwright/releases/download/skillwright/v<version>/install.sh | sh
   ```

   `install.sh` checks the binary against the release's `SHA256SUMS` and installs to `~/.local/bin`,
   or to the directory given with `--to`. Prebuilt binaries cover macOS and Linux, arm64 and x86_64.
   Windows is not supported.

   On macOS, a binary downloaded with a web browser is quarantined. The user must allow it in System
   Settings, Privacy & Security. The installers above are not affected.

3. If no channel has a `skillwright` package for this platform, build from source
   instead (Rust 1.89 or later):

   ```sh
   cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/osdlc/skillwright skillwright
   ```

   Run `skillwright --version` again. Stop and report the error if it still fails.

4. Look for a project file. skillwright reads the nearest `skillwright.yaml` above the working
   directory, or the file named with `--config`. If one exists, read it and stop. If you find a
   `tradecraft.yaml` instead, run `/migrate`.

5. Write `skillwright.yaml` by hand. `skillwright init` is declared but exits `not implemented`, and
   skillwright never writes its configuration files. A minimal file:

   ```yaml
   vault: skills-vault          # the folder of notes
   namespace: sw                # the frontmatter key prefix; sw is the default
   destinations:                # where `publish` writes
     - root: .
       target: claude-code
   marketplace:                 # what `build` renders
     name: house
     owner: me
     default_plugin: tools      # the plugin a note with no sw-plugin joins
     out: .                     # where the marketplace trees land
   ```

   Every key is optional. Relative paths resolve against the file's own folder. A flag overrides
   this file. The machine file `<config-home>/skillwright/config.yaml` (for example
   `~/Library/Application Support/skillwright/config.yaml` on macOS,
   `~/.config/skillwright/config.yaml` on Linux) fills in each key this file leaves out.
   `SKILLWRIGHT_MACHINE_CONFIG` names another machine file.

6. Create the vault folder and verify: run `skillwright list`. Exit code 4 means no configuration
   was found; check the file name and the working directory.
